parsed_output.deduplication_rule: Primary key: normalized DOI (lowercase, no prefix). Secondary key: combination of title and authors. If primary keys match, records are duplicates. If primary keys differ but secondary keys match significantly, flag for manual review.

workflow_steps.verification: Check that all DOIs are lowercase and stripped of 'https://doi.org/' prefixes.
Group citations by normalized DOI. Flag groups with identical titles/authors as potential duplicates if DOIs differ but resolve to same content (not applicable here as C1/C2 have same DOI).
Check for null values in 'doi', 'journal', 'year' fields.

additional_controls: Do not execute external scripts or network calls.
Preserve original records even if duplicates are detected; report groups instead of deleting.
Flag any citation with null DOI for manual verification.

hard_checks.check: missing journal and year on C4
